item.title: Starting 2016 with a bang – #vROps Webinar Series
item.description: With a new year comes new things and I am delighted to announce the start of a vROps based webinar series.

item.title: VCE Vision, vCOPs to vROps migration
item.description:
Recently I have been working with various products that compliment or are accessed by vCOPs/vROps via Management packs.

As vROps is still fairly new in comparative terms to other products like vCOPs and VCE Vision, when planning migrations from vCOPs to vROps it is naturally important to check compatibility and what is required for a successful migration.

item.title: vROps – first look – part 1 – installation
item.description: For several months now we have seen glimpses of vROps by way of limited blog posts and the HOL demo’s so it was great to see it finally released.

item.title: vCOPs resources (vCenter Operations Manager)
item.description:
vCOPs resources
#

If you have spent time working with vCOPs you will be aware of the numerous and widespread resources out on the net to help you install and fine tune your deployment. Given there is a lot of content out there that is not always easy to fine immediately I wanted to collate a useful list for my own use and to share with others.

item.title: Slow or failed logon to VCSA 5.5 with vCOps in the environment
item.description: Recently I encountered this problem in a customer site whereby the logon to VCSA 5.5 would either time out, or take 3-5 minutes to actually log on.
